name: Founding Endowment: Applied Anomalies Baseline Instrumentation
description: Founding allocation that established the anechoic measurement chain, the first contact-transducer bench and the archival capture rig on which the 2021 anomaly baseline was recorded.

name: Signal Recovery Instrumentation Grant
description: Funded the non-contact optical scanning rig and magnetic remanence imager used by the Signal Archaeology Group to recover unplayable lacquer, wax and magnetic media.

name: Browser Instrument Publication Fund
description: Underwrote the engineering of the publicly released browser instruments — the Acoustic Bench, SPECTRA//LAB, SYNTHESIS//SIGNAL and VOID//OCULUS — including accessibility and documentation passes.

name: Remote Listening Estate Grant
description: Established and hardened the autonomous field-station estate: hydrophone arrays, infrasound lines, solar and battery plant, and the telemetry backhaul for unattended long-duration listening.

name: Neural Resynthesis Fellowship Allocation
description: One-year fellowship allocation supporting latent-space audio research, feature-extraction tooling and the continuous latent synthesis work later published as a monograph.

name: Containment & Remediation Reserve Allocation
description: Standing allocation for post-incident containment, decommissioning and salvaged-component quarantine arising from the anomaly post-mortem programme. Drawn down per incident.

name: Perceptual Interface Fabrication Grant
description: CNC machining, actuator procurement and metrology time for the tactile floor arrays, motorised haptic controllers and microtonal touch surfaces built by the Perceptual Interfaces Group.

name: Speculative Disclosure Programme Grant
description: Supports the drafting, prior-art critique and public release of the speculative patent dossiers, including the review process that keeps design fiction clearly separated from legal filings.

name: Open Archive & Preservation Grant
description: Maintains this public archive: static prerendering, structured data, format migration, checksum verification of the revision ledger and long-term readability of deposited records.

name: Acoustic Ecology & Bioacoustic Monitoring Allocation
description: Supports soundscape ecology and bioacoustic monitoring at the sub-glacial and desert stations, including plant bio-electric transduction trials and anthropogenic noise baselining.
